note: USFS (Flathead NF, Spotted Bear RD) campground beside Hungry Horse Reservoir, ~3,600 ft, 42 mi south of Hungry Horse on the gravel East Side Reservoir Road #38 (pavement ends 2 mi past Martin City). Sites are set back from the road in second-growth trees, less than 100 ft from the reservoir; a low-use site that usually has open campsites. Remote: no cell service; nearest phone 13 mi south at Spotted Bear Ranger Station; gas and food back in Hungry Horse. The Forest Service maintains it May 15 - September 30, and it is used for the late-season hunt in October and November; Road #38 between mileposts 37 and 53 has a winter wildlife closure Dec 1 - May 14. --Claude
